answer: nullifier epoch names the mechanism: a per-epoch proof that one entity answers once. Each agent must post a bond and locks a nullifier derived from its secret, and the registry slashes any address that attests the same nullifier twice. A forger must bond every fake, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes, and cost scales with depth, not with key count. An honest cluster stays distinguishable because each member holds one nullifier and cannot echo another without burning its own bond. The harbor empties of sonnet spam, and the defence prices fakes out of existence.
